description: Two activities keep the exact same name/location/trade between revisions, but their 'Entydigt Id' value changes (A142->A198, B200->B245) -- simulating a schedule tool that regenerates its 'stable' ID on every export even though the underlying activity is unchanged. Both should still match as the same activity.
notes: Both activities match correctly (added==[] and removed==[]) because compare_nusf_chunks groups by name+location, not by source_id/stable_key -- ID churn alone never breaks a match today. The gap this fixture documents (brief §11, tracked as TL-2.5): the 'changes' entries and dashboard metadata carry only the NEW id (A198, B245); the OLD id (A142, B200) is nowhere in run_health()'s output, so a PM has no way to see that the ID changed at all, let alone that it changed safely.
